text.description_html:
Brass Accents A05-P7230 Decorative Ribbon and Reed Door Push Plate 2-1/2" Wide x 13-3/4" High

This plate set is done in the Louis XVI style c. 1774-1789. The style really began in the second part of the reign of Louis XVI. The use of the ribbon and reed elements can be traced to the Greek ruins of Pompeii, brought to France Greek archaeological sites around 1760.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available Matching: Ribbon And Reed Door Pull

Specifications for Brass Accents A05-P7230 Decorative Ribbon and Reed Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 2-1/2"
  • Plate Height: 13-3/4"
  • Material: Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
